regions.title: Northern Rockies
regions.text: Jackson Hole is forecast for about 31", 16" of it Friday. Grand Targhee and Big Sky follow. The NWS is calling for more at Grand Targhee: 26 to 47 inches Friday through Tuesday night. Winter Storm Warning at Jackson Hole from Friday to Saturday.

regions.title: Northeast
regions.text: Jay Peak is forecast for about 28". Mont-Sainte-Anne and Le Massif follow. The National Weather Service has rain mixed in at Jay Peak Friday night. Winter Weather Advisory at Jay Peak from Thursday to Friday.

regions.title: Wasatch
regions.text: Brighton is forecast for about 24", 14" of it Tuesday. Alta and Snowbird follow.

regions.title: Cascades
regions.text: Mt. Bachelor is forecast for about 26". Mt. Baker and Crystal Mountain follow. The National Weather Service has rain mixed in at Mt. Bachelor Monday.

regions.title: Tahoe
regions.text: Kirkwood is forecast for about 27". Palisades and Sugar Bowl follow. The National Weather Service has heavy snow at Kirkwood Monday night and Tuesday.

regions.title: Eastern Sierra
regions.text: Mammoth is forecast for about 20", 18" of it Tuesday. The National Weather Service has heavy snow at Mammoth Monday night and Tuesday. The NWS is calling for more at Mammoth: 22 to 37 inches Sunday night through Tuesday night.

regions.title: Coast Mountains
regions.text: Cypress Mountain is forecast for about 22", 13" of it Monday. Whistler follows. Environment Canada has rain mixed in at Whistler Monday night.

regions.title: Central Rockies
regions.text: Steamboat is forecast for about 24", 17" of it Saturday. Arapahoe Basin and Vail follow. The NWS is calling for more at Arapahoe Basin: 10 to 18 inches Friday night through Saturday night. Winter Weather Advisory at Steamboat from Friday to Sunday.

regions.title: Kootenays
regions.text: Whitewater is forecast for about 12", 8" of it Monday. Revelstoke and RED Mountain follow. Environment Canada has rain mixed in at Whitewater Monday and Monday night.

regions.title: Okanagan
regions.text: SilverStar is forecast for about 7", 4" of it Monday. Big White and Sun Peaks follow. Environment Canada has rain mixed in at SilverStar Monday and Monday night.

sources.name: NOAA buoys 51001 / 51101 (method: Powder Buoy, Mike Ruzek)

buoy.text: Buoys 51001 and 51101 near Hawaii popped Nov 25, the swell signal Powder Buoy watches for a Wasatch storm about two weeks later — here Dec 6–12. In past winters a pop raised the chance of a Wasatch storm in that window by roughly 6 to 12 points. Experimental: promising, not proven.
